messages.security_this_page_is_for_conte: Security: this page is for content super-admins only. Bundled JSON must not contain real project URLs or keys—use your Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API values below. Resetting local app config (agri_home_config) does not sign you out. If a config write secret was set locally, it is kept when applying factory defaults so publishing can continue.
messages.configure_your_self_hosted_supa: Configure your self-hosted Supabase project. This connection is shared by IM messaging, Cloud AI, push notifications, login auth, and all backend features. Anon Key is public and safe for frontend.
messages.not_configured_fill_in_the_fiel: Not configured — fill in the fields below

messages.anon_key_is_public_identifies_p: Anon Key is public (identifies project), NOT the Service Role Key. Dashboard → Settings → API → anon public
messages.affects_images_videos_uploaded_: Affects images/videos uploaded from the Content Manager (banners, articles, rich text). For non-Supabase, set Edge Secrets CMS_R2_* / CMS_ALIYUN_* / CMS_TENCENT_* — see project docs. Chat media still uses Supabase Storage.
messages.please_fill_in_url_and_anon_key: Please fill in URL and Anon Key first
messages.test_failed_open_developer_tool: Test failed. Open Developer Tools (F12) and check the Console.
messages.only_anon_key_public_is_stored_: Only Anon Key (public) is stored here. All API keys/secrets must be in server-side env vars (Supabase Secrets, Cloudflare env, etc.)
messages.service_role_key_must_never_be_: Service Role Key must NEVER be in frontend code
messages.the_top_preview_button_saves_lo: The top “Preview” button saves locally for in-app review only; “Push to cloud” syncs config to the server. Farmer/store apps merge remote config on open or when returning to foreground. Status below shows the last remote fetch and version.
messages.customize_the_icon_and_text_for: Customize the icon and text for the three feature sections on the homepage. Leave fields empty to use multilingual defaults or default icons.

messages.ai_pest_disease_detection_model: AI Pest & Disease Detection Model Config
messages.online_deep_analysis_uses_third: Online deep analysis uses third-party cloud LLMs (via Supabase Edge). Local ONNX and online AI can be toggled independently; default is online only. When online AI is off, no cloud requests are made. When local is off, the app does not fall back to on-device inference offline.
messages.current_both_local_and_online_a: Current: Both local and online AI are off — the farmer app cannot use AI.
messages.current_cloud_when_online_offli: Current: Cloud when online; offline can use local ONNX (model URL set).
messages.current_cloud_when_online_local: Current: Cloud when online; local is on but without a valid model URL, offline use is limited.
messages.current_third_party_online_ai_o: Current: Third-party online AI only (no deep analysis offline, no local fallback).
messages.current_local_onnx_only_configu: Current: Local ONNX only (configure model URL; no cloud calls).
messages.when_off_the_app_does_not_load_: When off, the app does not load or run on-device models, even offline.
messages.supports_any_publicly_accessibl: Supports any publicly accessible URL (OSS, CDN, GitHub Release, etc.), file must be in ONNX format
messages.json_array_format_e_g_rice_blas: JSON array format, e.g.: ["Rice Blast","Powdery Mildew","Aphids",...]
messages.not_configured_will_use_local_f: Not configured (will use local files or demo mode)
messages.train_your_pest_disease_detecti: Train your pest & disease detection model with your dataset
messages.export_to_onnx_python_export_mo: Export to ONNX: python export_model.py --format onnx --imgsz 640

messages.paste_the_urls_into_the_fields_: Paste the URLs into the fields above, save config to apply
messages.configure_third_party_cloud_vis: Configure third-party cloud vision models (Qwen, Gemini, GPT-4o, etc.). Requests go to the Edge proxy only when this is on and the device is online. When off, the app does not call the cloud (no demo mock). Secrets live only in Edge env vars.
messages.on_cloud_deep_analysis_when_onl: On: cloud deep analysis when online. Off: no cloud requests.
messages.supabase_for_cloud_vision_only_: Supabase for cloud vision only (independent of IM). If set, used first; if empty, falls back to the Backend Proxy tab URL/key (IM toggle not required).
messages.shown_in_ui_so_users_know_which: Shown in UI so users know which AI model is used

messages.controls_the_length_of_ai_gener: Controls the length of AI-generated reports. Recommended: 512-2048

messages.all_cloud_ai_api_keys_qwen_api_: All cloud AI API keys (QWEN_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, etc.) must be Supabase Edge Function Secrets
messages.this_config_only_stores_display: This config only stores display name and model ID — no secrets involved
messages.enter_supabase_url_anon_key_abo: Enter Supabase URL/anon key above for cloud AI, or only under Backend Proxy and leave these empty (fallback; IM toggle not required)
messages.read_secrets_via_deno_env_get_q: Read secrets via Deno.env.get('QWEN_API_KEY') in the Edge Function
messages.receive_from_frontend: Receive { image, detections, modelId, systemPrompt, maxTokens } from frontend
messages.route_to_the_correct_cloud_api_: Route to the correct cloud API based on modelId (Qwen/Gemini/OpenAI)
messages.this_app_uses_supabase_realtime: This app uses Supabase Realtime as the single IM channel. Keys and Service Role stay in the Supabase dashboard (Project Settings / Edge Function Secrets); the frontend only reads the public URL and anon key.
messages.postgres_realtime_storage_edge_: Postgres + Realtime + Storage + Edge Functions: messages, media, and bindings all flow through Supabase.
messages.deploy_edge_server_chat_supabas: Deploy Edge: server, chat-supabase, merchant-bind-resolve, ai-vision-proxy; run `supabase/migrations/001_init.sql`; merchant QR short link: https://your-domain/m/{merchant_user_id}

messages.enabled_but_url_invalid_please_: Enabled but URL invalid, please enter correct Supabase URL
messages.disabled_mock_mode_chat_and_cal: Disabled (Mock Mode — chat and calls are simulated locally)
messages.service_role_key_only_lives_in_: Service Role Key only lives in Supabase Edge Function Secrets, never in the frontend.

messages.rls_ensures_store_farmer_only_r: RLS ensures store/farmer only reads their own rows in chat_messages / merchant_farmer_channels / farmer_merchant_bindings.

messages.enable_only_login_methods_commo: Enable only login methods common in your target market (e.g. China: WeChat + phone; international: Google + Apple + email)

messages.writes_user_profiles_by_supabas: Writes user_profiles by Supabase Auth user UUID: content_role is none or editor; app_role is farmer or distributor. This page cannot grant content admin.

messages.headers_must_resolve_to_user_id: Headers must resolve to user_id, content_role, app_role (Chinese hints OK). Values: lowercase none, editor, farmer, distributor — no checkmarks. Blank = skip field. Batches of 200.
messages.when_a_farmer_scans_a_merchant_: When a farmer scans a merchant QR in Community, the URL hostname must match an entry here. Root domains allow subdomains. If empty, the app rejects all merchant-bind scans.
messages.signed_in_users_community_and_p: Signed-in users: Community and Profile use DB column user_profiles.app_role (farmer / distributor), not this toggle. Set app_role in Supabase SQL or Dashboard. This switch is only a fallback when the role is unavailable or Edge fails, plus offline defaults.
messages.farmer_single_contact_full_page: Farmer: single-contact full-page chat (default). Store: recents + contacts + multiple threads; data accumulates on the store device.
messages.please_sign_in_with_your_supaba: Please sign in with your Supabase-backed account first.
messages.this_session_is_offline_demo_mo: This session is offline demo mode. Use phone, email, or social login linked to Supabase.

messages.or_paste_external_url_e_g_cloud: Or paste external URL (e.g. Cloudflare R2)
